ITEM 1 | Sliced green vegetable in thin half-moon rounds with pale green flesh and darker green skin edges, some slices slightly translucent and glossy with moisture, lying in a loose overlapping pile covering the right half of the plate, roughly 14 cm across and 1.5 cm tall in the pile | 190
ITEM 2 | Cooked meat in irregular bite-sized chunks, light to medium brown with darker browned edges, fibrous shredded texture pulling apart in strands, slightly moist with a few pale fatty streaks, clustered on the left side of the plate about 10 cm across and 2 cm tall, with a small reddish-orange fleck and a pale green bit visible among the pieces | 150
